'''Lindo Peate''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
As a young man, Lindo Peate spent a couple of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] residing in in a place of contemplation and study. He later joined the [[Intarsa League]], a criminal faction led by the [[Force Adept]] [[Dersa Welles]], and around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Neeblo accompanied the League on a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] journey to the world [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. En-route, the shuttle was ambushed en-route by rivals of the Intarsa League and the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] crash-landed in the grounds of the [[Blue Star Centre]], a [[Philosopher/Legends|philosophical]] research facility located near to the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Gadrin]]. Soon afterward, Peate and the surviving members of the Intarsa League entered the Blue Star Centre and took the facility's inhabitants hostage in an attempt to gain passage off of Cularin. Peate felt uneasy about the League's seizure of the facility because it was similar to the place of contemplation that he visited while a young man and he was determined to ensure that the Blue Star Centre's inhabitants came to no harm, even if protecting them brought him into conflict with the other members of league. However, the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents who operated in and around the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], [[Skirmish in the Blue Star Centre|attacked]] the Intarsa League and defeated Peate and the other crash survivors to free the hostages.
